support_sampling: uniform without replacement, no class quotas
label_rule: eligible rows with explicit compatible fine labels; no coarse-to-fine invention; reject category/subcategory conflicts
input_adapter: same single image copied to both base input channels; same image to SSL
encoder_scope: Frozen source paired R50 receives the same single FUSAR image in both input channels; SSL R18 receives that same image as RGB. No second polarization is invented. F0921 SSL pretraining is unchanged.
